turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Hi, thanks for coming in today. What's been going on for you lately?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My partner basically made me come. I don't think it's as big a deal as they're making it out to be, honestly. I mean, I'm fine, I can handle it.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like you're feeling frustrated. Is there anything else going on that you'd like to talk about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Not really. I just don't see what the big deal is. They're just being dramatic. (pauses, slightly irritated) Look, can we just get this over with? I'm not really sure why I'm here.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like you're feeling frustrated and overwhelmed. Is there anything else going on that you'd like to talk about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (scoffs) Oh, you think I'm frustrated? That's cute. Yeah, I'm fine. I just need to... (pauses, looking for the right words) ...get my head straight, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: It sounds like you're feeling overwhelmed and need some time to process your thoughts and feelings. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) I don't know... I mean, I just need to figure some stuff out, I guess. It's not like anything's really wrong. (pauses, looking away) Can we just... (trails off)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sure. Is there anything else you need to talk about?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shakes head) No, that's it. I think. (sits in silence for a moment, then looks back at the therapist)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (sighs) I don't know... Maybe just talk to my partner about this, I guess. They're the ones who are always on my case about it. (looks down, fidgeting with hands)

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (shrugs) No, I think that's it. I'll just... (pauses, looking for the right words) ...try to get my stuff together, I guess.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Sounds like a plan. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (gets defensive) Look, I appreciate the effort, but I don't need a whole plan or anything. I just need to... (pauses, taking a deep breath) ...deal with it myself, okay?

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Okay. Is there anything else I can do to help?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (folding arms, becoming more guarded) No, I think that's enough.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: Alright. I'm here if you need anything else.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: (nods curtly, then stands up, indicating the session is over) Yeah, thanks.

turns.speaker: therapist
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a good day.
